issues.detail: The Greek verb 'επερωτων' (asked/questioned) is rendered as a statement of the crowd asking, but the Vietnamese translation omits the specific action of the crowd questioning him. More importantly, the Greek 'τι ουν ποιησομεν' implies a sense of 'then what shall we do?' (the 'oun' is a connective/consecutive). While the Vietnamese captures the question, it misses the nuance of the 'questioning' as an action performed by the crowds upon Him.
